import json, random, sys
r = random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 7)
npkt = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20000
C, E, K, W, F = 8, 4, 5, 16, 8
S = 256
L = 4
cfg = {
    "slots": S, "window": W, "idle_timeout": 10**12, "len_quantum": 1,
    "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 10**6, "rate_den": 1,
    "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512,
    "lanes": L, "service": [1] * C, "fallback": 0,
    "time_edges": [0, 5, 100], "count_edges": [0, 3, 9],
    "probability": [[65536] * 3 for _ in range(3)],
}
model = {
    "classes": C, "embedding_dim": E,
    "length_embedding": [[r.randint(-128, 127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
    "gap_embedding": [[r.randint(-128, 127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
    "kernel": K,
    "conv_weights": [[[r.randint(-128, 127) for _ in range(2 * E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
    "conv_bias": [r.randint(-2**31, 2**31 - 1) for _ in range(F)],
    "conv_shift": [r.randint(0, 16) for _ in range(F)],
    "dense_weights": [[r.randint(-128, 127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
    "dense_bias": [r.randint(-2**31, 2**31 - 1) for _ in range(C)],
}
conns = [{"id": "conn-%04d" % i, "slot": i % S, "label": i % C,
          "split": "dev" if i % 2 else "eval"} for i in range(2048)]
pkts = []
t = 0
for i in range(npkt):
    t += 1
    pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": conns[i % 2048]["id"],
                 "length": r.randint(0, 65535), "draw": r.randint(0, 65535)})
doc = {"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": model, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(doc))
PYEOF
